C-GT-AUTO-WORKSHOP.Summary: Implement the selected Workshop GT Auto concept with real car specifications, engine swaps, special parts and saved build plans.
C-GT-AUTO-WORKSHOP.Problem: GT Auto currently offers static reference counters without car-specific data or an adaptive workshop.

Goals.Goal: Persistent selected car with official photo and specifications, right-hand service menu on wide screens and stacked layout on narrow screens.
Load real GTPlus engine compatibility and comparison data and HRC Rolls special-parts compatibility with explicit provenance, unknown states and retry.
Search the car catalogue and persist selected car and per-car build plans locally.

Constraints.Constraint: Use existing Provider architecture, FVM SDK, separate source services and repository composition; preserve prior Apex and audio edits.
No inferred incompatibility from missing data, no invented parts effects or arbitrary PP calculation; distinguish official stock figures from community swap figures.
No installed-game-state claims; wide-body availability remains unknown without a source.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No telemetry, Profile or dealer redesign; no repair of the deferred native renderer crash.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: GT Auto opens the selected Workshop design with car search, specifications, swaps, parts and build plan.
Sources are fetched once per session with manual refresh, partial failures preserve available data, and malformed payloads surface retryable errors.
Resolve GTPlus references and join by official car code; special-parts joins require unique exact normalized names and preserve unknown values.
Actual taps select engines and parts and plans survive restart without mixing cars.
Check 320, 390, 600, 820, 1024, 1280 and 1920 logical widths and enlarged text in widget tests; inspect the running macOS app at multiple window sizes.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Targeted analyzer and GT Auto tests
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Live network records and native app screenshots at narrow and wide window sizes.

Assumptions.Assumption: The user's explicit instruction on 2026-10-25 approves the selected Workshop concept and sequential implementation, verification and lifecycle completion.
Community sites have no stable documented API; failures must be visible instead of using invented fallback records.
